children.counts: Call-and-response 4-count rhythms echoing the leader's stamping patterns.
children.game_version: Play a suitor stamina freeze game: children stamp their feet with light shakers tied to their ankles, freezing instantly when the drum stops to see who maintains balance.

seniors.counts: Simple 4-count or 8-count regular marching beats aligned with the primary drum pulse.
seniors.seated_version: Perform seated rhythmic heel-and-toe taps to activate lighter handheld rattles, accompanied by gentle seated torso swaying and seated hip shifts.
seniors.standing_version: Gentle low-impact alternate stepping while holding a chair back for support, keeping feet low to the floor and focusing on rhythmic clarity over impact.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo by half; restrict pelvic motion to small comfortable ranges and eliminate rapid spins.

movement_profile.footwork: Rhythmic, continuous stamping and stepping that sounds leg-mounted rattles, executed in counts coordinated with live drum cues.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Fluid transitions between circular processions, opposing lines of male and female dancers, and paired face-to-face courtship formations.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Accented hip isolations, rotations, and shaking emphasized by beaded waist rings, contrasted with dynamic upper-body control during jumps and spins.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Frequent high leaps, spins, and explosive elevation changes by male dancers balanced by grounded, low-to-mid level travel by female dancers.
movement_profile.partnering: Non-contact courtship pairings where male athletic displays confront and complement female graceful hip work.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, athletic posture for male dancers with knees primed for explosive leaps; grounded, balanced posture for female dancers facilitating fluid pelvic articulation.

signature_moves.description: Rapid, high-impact foot strikes designed to make the calabash leg rattles crack rhythmically in time with the drums.
signature_moves.name: Ebinyege Stamping

signature_moves.description: Controlled circular and shaking hip isolations that mobilize beaded waist rings to demonstrate poise and grace.
signature_moves.name: Entogoro Hip Accentuation

signature_moves.description: High vertical leaps and rotational spins executed by male suitors to demonstrate strength, stamina, and agility.
signature_moves.name: Courting Solo Jumps

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Energetic, driving, and demanding high physical stamina.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid sluggish foot contact that mutes or mistimes the leg rattles; avoid rigid hip posture that prevents the natural movement of the waist rings.

music_profile.musical_form: Call-and-response driven by the omukama and lead drummers, shifting through variable tempo and intensity sections
music_profile.sound_description: A dense, driving percussive texture generated by acoustic drum patterns and punctuated by the sharp, dry shake of gourd rattles bound to the male dancers' legs. Layered over this rhythmic bed are the melodic counterpoints of traditional wooden flutes and resonant xylophones, punctuated by call-and-response chants, vocal praises, and jokes delivered by the master of ceremonies.
music_profile.vocal_style: Chanted praises, sung refrains, and humorous spoken banter led by the master of ceremonies (omukama)

basic_steps: Fast rhythmic foot stamping to activate the ebinyege leg rattles in synchronization with the drum rhythm.
Isolated rhythmic hip swaying and rotational shaking to move the entogoro waist ring.
Synchronized circular and linear group travel following the calls of the omukama.
Improvised individual solo displays featuring rapid spins and elevation jumps.
teaching.formation: Circles, lines, and pairs moving synchronously under the direction of an omukama
teaching.level_notes: Beginners must develop calf and ankle endurance for sustained stamping while maintaining separate pelvic isolation.
teaching.rhythm: Dynamic polyrhythmic drum accompaniment with matching percussive rattle accents
